motions.motion: Councilmember Wood nominates Councilmember Brett Wright as Mayor Pro Tempore for 2025. Councilmember Gray seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Brett Wright named mayor pro tempore for 2025
motions.summary: The council named Councilmember Brett Wright as mayor pro tempore for 2025.
motions.impact: Nothing changes for residents — this simply decides who leads a council meeting when the mayor cannot be there.

motions.item_title: Approve the appointment of Adam Jacobs for a three year term, through 2027, to the Library Advi…
motions.motion: Councilmember Clark moved to approve the appointment of Adam Jacobs for a three year term, through 2027, to the Library Advisory Board. Councilmember Wood seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Adam Jacobs joins the Library Advisory Board
motions.summary: The council appointed Adam Jacobs to a three-year term on the Library Advisory Board, running through 2027.
motions.impact: Nothing changes for library users — this fills one volunteer seat on the board that advises the city on the library.

motions.headline: Benjamin Perez joins the Library Advisory Board
motions.summary: The council appointed Benjamin Perez to a three-year term on the Library Advisory Board, running through 2027.

motions.motion: Councilmember Clark moved to adopt the Consent Agenda. Councilmember Wood seconded the motion. Councilmembers clarified the changes to the Consent Agenda that were made during the Work Session in relation to the fiscal year financial audit. AMENDED MOTION: Councilmember Clark moved to adopt the Consent Agenda with the changes as discussed in Work Session to the audit. Councilmember Wood seconded the motion. Councilmembers clarified changes to the Consent Agenda to include the appointment of City Recorder Gina Olsen. AMENDED MOTION: Councilmember Clark moved to adopt the Consent Agenda with the changes as discussed in Work Session to the audit and appointing Gina Olsen as Eagle Mountain City Recorder. Councilmember Wood seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Consent agenda and new city recorder approved
motions.summary: The council passed its consent agenda, including changes to the year's financial audit discussed in work session, and appointed Gina Olsen as city recorder.
motions.impact: Nothing changes day to day — this is the batch of routine items the council passes together, plus the staff appointment that keeps the city's official records.

motions.item_title: An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the General Plan Future Land Use Map for Certain Lands Known as Cedar Corners Phase 5 and continue the Public Hearing
motions.motion: Councilmember Wood moved to table an Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the General Plan Future Land Use Map for Certain Lands Known as Cedar Corners Phase 5 and continue the Public Hearing. Councilmember Clark seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Cedar Corners land-use map change put off
motions.summary: The council delayed a change to the city's future land use map for Cedar Corners Phase 5 and left its public hearing open.
motions.impact: Nothing changes yet for the Cedar Corners area — the city's long-range map for the site stays as is, and the hearing remains open for comment.

motions.item_title: An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Rezoning Certain Lands Known as Cedar Corners Phase 5 and continue the Public Hearing
motions.motion: Councilmember Wood moved to table an Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Rezoning Certain Lands Known as Cedar Corners Phase 5 and continue the Public Hearing. Councilmember Clark seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Cedar Corners Phase 5 rezoning put off
motions.summary: The council delayed a decision on rezoning the land known as Cedar Corners Phase 5 and left its public hearing open.
motions.impact: If you live near Cedar Corners, nothing changes yet — the current zoning stays, and you will still be able to speak when the hearing resumes.

motions.item_title: An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Section 17.25.060 Projection into Setbacks
motions.motion: Councilmember Burnham moved to adopt an Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Section 17.25.060 Projection into Setbacks. Councilmember Wright seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Rules changed for building into yard setbacks
motions.summary: The council amended the city code rule governing how far a structure may project into a required yard setback.
motions.impact: If you are planning to build near your property line, the limits on how far a structure can extend into the setback have changed. The motion itself does not state the new limits — check with the city first.

motions.item_title: An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Section 16.10.080 Criteria for Approval of MDAs and changing section F to read “Expired or otherwise terminated agreements upon expiration or termination of a Master Development Agreement or a Development Agreement that zoned property, the Planning Director shall initiate proceedings to rezone the land.” Also, enacting Section 17.90.090 Rezone Initiation Post Development Agreement Expiration or Termination with the following change in 17.90.090 to read “Expired or otherwise terminated agreements upon expiration or termination of a Master Development Agreement or a Development Agreement that zoned property, the Planning Director shall initiate proceedings to rezone the land.” Councilmember Burnham seconded the motion
motions.motion: Councilmember Wood moved to adopt an Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Section 16.10.080 Criteria for Approval of MDAs and changing section F to read “Expired or otherwise terminated agreements upon expiration or termination of a Master Development Agreement or a Development Agreement that zoned property, the Planning Director shall initiate proceedings to rezone the land.” Also, enacting Section 17.90.090 Rezone Initiation Post Development Agreement Expiration or Termination with the following change in 17.90.090 to read “Expired or otherwise terminated agreements upon expiration or termination of a Master Development Agreement or a Development Agreement that zoned property, the Planning Director shall initiate proceedings to rezone the land.” Councilmember Burnham seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Expired development deals now trigger rezoning
motions.summary: The council required the planning director to start rezoning land whenever a master development agreement or development agreement on it expires or is terminated.
motions.impact: If you own land covered by a development agreement that lapses, the city will move to rezone it rather than leave the old zoning in place. Most residents will not notice this.

motions.item_title: An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Section 17.100.050 Site Plan Development Standards clarifying the method of measuring and also clarifying from the distance of existing right-of-way, not existing curb, and a diagram to give direction to that effect
motions.motion: Councilmember Wood moved to table an Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Section 17.100.050 Site Plan Development Standards clarifying the method of measuring and also clarifying from the distance of existing right-of-way, not existing curb, and a diagram to give direction to that effect. Councilmember Gray seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Setback measuring change delayed
motions.summary: The council put off a change to how the city measures setbacks on site plans, measuring from the existing right-of-way instead of the curb.
motions.impact: Nothing changes for now. The current measuring rules stay in place for anyone submitting a site plan until the council takes the item up again.

motions.item_title: A Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Authorizing Staff to Engage the Services of a Third-Party Broker for Major Land Acquisition and Disposal of Significant Land.
motions.motion: Councilmember Wood moved to adopt a Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Authorizing Staff to Engage the Services of a Third-Party Real Estate Brokerage or Real Estate Attorney for Major Land Acquisition and Disposal of Significant Real Property in accordance with the changes stated. Councilmember Gray seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Outside brokers allowed for big city land deals
motions.summary: The city authorized staff to hire a real estate brokerage or a real estate attorney when buying or selling major city property.
motions.impact: Nothing changes day to day — this only sets who the city can bring in to handle its larger land purchases and sales.

motions.item_title: Table the Assignment of City Council Board Liaisons position and continue with our 2024 assignm…
motions.motion: Councilmember Clark moved to table the Assignment of City Council Board Liaisons position and continue with our 2024 assignments until such time that the Mayor can meet with councilmembers to determine the new assignments. Councilmember Burnham seconded the motion. Eagle Mountain City Council Agenda – January 7, 2025 Page 11 of 13 Councilmember Wood requested that the City Manager prepare a list of all potential boards and commissions for City Council review. AMENDED MOTION: Councilmember Clark moved to table the Assignment of City Council Board Liaisons position and continue with our 2024 assignments until such time that the Mayor can meet with councilmembers to determine the new assignments and request our City Manager meet with the Mayor and prepare a list for City Council of all potential boards and commissions that the City wants a liaison. Councilmember Burnham seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Council board assignments put on hold
motions.summary: The council kept its 2024 board liaison assignments until the mayor can meet with members to set new ones, and asked staff for a list of all boards.
motions.impact: Nothing changes for residents — this is internal housekeeping about which councilmember sits in on which city board and commission.
